questions.question: The maximum temperature of the day occurs generally ___________.
questions.solution:
The correct answer__** is in the afternoon.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The maximum temperature of the day occurs generally in the afternoon while the minimum temperature occurs generally in the early morning
 
• Daily air temperatures at Earth's surface are controlled by the incoming and outgoing energy.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• During the day, the air temperature increases as energy gains exceed the energy lost from Earth's surface.
 
• Throughout the night, the air temperature decreases as Earth's surface loses more energy than it receives

questions.question: Select the correct statement

options.text: There are only 2 basic components of a cell-cytoplasm and nucleus.
The cytoplasm and nucleus are enclosed within the cell membrane, also called the plasma membrane.
The membrane separates ribosomes and mitochondria of a cell.
The plasma membrane does not allow inward movement of the substance.

questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**The cytoplasm and nucleus are enclosed within the cell membrane, also called the plasma membrane**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The plasma membrane, also called the cell membrane, is the membrane found in all cells that separate the interior of the cell from the outside environment
 
• In bacterial and plant cells, a cell wall is attached to the plasma membrane on its outside surface.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Biological membranes have primary functions
 
• They keep toxic substances out of the cell
 
• They contain receptors and channels that allow specific molecules, such as ions, nutrients, wastes, and metabolic products.

 [IMAGE: https://upload.wikimedia.org/wikipedia/commons/thumb/3/3a/Cell_membrane_detailed_diagram_4.svg/400px-Cell_membrane_detailed_diagram_4.svg.png]

questions.question: Which of the following novels was written by the famous Indian novelist Amrita Pritam?
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Raseedi Ticket.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• Amrita Pritam was an Indian novelist, essayist and poet, who wrote in Punjabi and Hindi.
 
• A prominent figure in Punjabi literature, she is the recipient of the 1956 Sahitya Akademi.
 
• Raseedi Ticket is Amrita Pritam's celebrated autobiography, which tells us how she felt distressed at the influence of hate; she was traumatised by the horrors of the Partition, out of which her poem 'Vaaris Shah' was born.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

__
 
• Midnight's Children__ is a 1981 novel by Salman Rushdie, published by Jonathan Cape with cover design by Bill Botten, about India's transition from British colonial rule to independence and partition
 
• The__ Story of My Experiments with __Truth is the autobiography of Mahatma Gandhi, covering his life from early childhood through to 1921. It was written in weekly installments and published in his journal Navjivan from 1925 to 1929. 
 
• __Train to Pakistan__ is a historical novel by writer Khushwant Singh, published in 1956. It recounts the Partition of India in August 1947

questions.question: In the Indian constitution, the Right to Freedom is covered from ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is__** Article 19 to 22**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The right to freedom gives citizens basic freedom with respect to speech and expression, form associations, freedom of personal liberty, freedom to live a life of dignity, etc.
 
• It is important to understand the scope of these provisions and any exceptions thereof.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** The fundamental rights were originally provided by the Constitution 

 
• Right to equality (Article 14–18)
 
• Right to freedom (Article 19–22)
 
• Right against exploitation (Article 23–24)
 
• Right to freedom of religion (Article 25–28)
 
• Cultural and educational rights (Article 29–30)
 
• Right to constitutional remedies (Article 32)
 
• Right to Education (Article 21A)

questions.question: The Janjira Fort is situated on a small island in the Arabian sea, off the coast of ______.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is __**Maharashtra**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Janjira is a colloquial and a more localized form of the **Arabic word Jazeera that means island**.
 
• The origin of this majestic fort can be traced down to the fifteenth century when some **local fishermen of Rajapuri** constructed a small **wooden fort on a huge rock** to protect themselves and their families from the pirate.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• It is considered to be India's strongest marine fort. While some records state that it was built as early as **1100**, more recent records show that **Murud-Janjira was built at the end of the 17th c entury.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b15c8c9282071adc51b9cae5cedcb4b7c599c286303916e8a92ac48f2386aac5.png] **
